name: Change of Control — German-related Commercial Contracts
governing_law_handling: Detect explicit clause; mark unknown if absent. Never infer solely from language.

rules.name: Direct/indirect transfer
rules.trigger: Contract explicitly references direct or indirect change of control, including ultimate ownership where the contract so provides

rules.name: Notice requirement
rules.trigger: Contract specifies notification following control change

rules.name: Deemed assignment
rules.trigger: Contract deems a qualifying change of control an assignment requiring consent
rules.exception: Check permitted assignments, affiliate exceptions and definition of control
